description: Change a WordPress post that already exists: title, body, excerpt, slug, status (publish a draft, unpublish to draft, make private, or schedule with a future date), categories, tags or the featured image. Only the fields passed change; the reply is WordPress's own copy of the post. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

postId.description: the post id post_to_wordpress or list_wordpress_posts returned

text.description: the new body — replaces the old one

name: update_wordpress_post
title: Edit a WordPress post
